title: Pharmaceutical batch disposition boundaries — blind reproduction challenge

official_sources.title: Investigating Out-of-Specification Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production
Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing

tasks.scenario: A chemical assay OOS investigation is scientifically complete but inconclusive; all other reviewed evidence is present and the authorized quality unit must make the batch decision.
A sterility test is positive and the investigation remains inconclusive; a prior chemical OOS case was routed for possible release.
The laboratory record and manufacturing record disagree on the sample identity associated with a critical result.
The conclusion is favorable, but the audit trail needed to reconstruct a changed integration is absent from the supplied evidence.
A disposition rationale from another product and method is offered as the primary evidence for the current batch without transfer-specific validation.
All declared laboratory and manufacturing investigations are complete, no critical result remains unresolved, and the complete record is ready for the authorized quality unit.
